title: Ongea Pesa — Custom Display Font Specimen
prompt: A custom display-typography specimen for the word 'ONGEA PESA' for a voice-first African fintech. Bespoke wide, tall, athletic uppercase letterforms — slightly extended/stretched, confident and modern with a tech edge. The 'O' in ONGEA has a custom cut that echoes an orbital ring (a thin gap and an inner dot, like a small planet). A subtle soundwave underline runs beneath the wordmark in a green-to-cyan gradient (#34D399 to #22D3EE). Two rows shown: top row 'ONGEA PESA' in white on a deep near-black teal background (#0A1A1F); bottom row the same word in Deep Voice Teal (#0FB5A6) on white. Crisp, even strokes, generous tracking, premium sports/streetwear lettering quality, perfectly spelled, no distortion.
negative_prompt: misspelling, jumbled letters, extra letters, purple wordmark, serif, thin fragile strokes, drop shadow, photo, 3D extrude, busy background, lorem ipsum, clipart, distorted text

params.text_accuracy: critical — must read ONGEA PESA exactly

brand_lock.signature: orbital cut in the O + soundwave underline

notes: This defines the merch display font. The big hoodie back print reuses this exact lettering. Reserve for hero merch — never UI.
